changelog_entries.title: Deployment Storage keeps your deployments rollback-ready
changelog_entries.description: Deployment Storage is now measured and billed at $0.10 per GB per month for new Pro and Enterprise teams. Control retention in Deployment History.

changelog_entries.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental now available on AI Gateway
changelog_entries.description: Call DeepSeek V4 Flash with image input through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key, a 1M token context window, fallbacks, and a trace on every request.

changelog_entries.title: Connect v0 apps to Slack, Google, and 100+ other services
changelog_entries.description: Apps and agents built in v0 can now securely connect to 100+ third-party services, including Slack, Google, Notion, GitHub, and Salesforce, through Vercel Connect.

changelog_entries.title: Always-on tracing for production and preview traffic
changelog_entries.description: Always-on tracing collects sampled traces from your production and preview traffic, so you can debug real requests without reproducing them.

changelog_entries.title: Manage Vercel Toolbar comments from the CLI
changelog_entries.description: List, inspect, reply to, and resolve Vercel Toolbar comments from the terminal with the new vercel comments command.

changelog_entries.title: Custom metrics are now supported in Vercel Observability
changelog_entries.description: Emit your own metrics from Vercel Functions and analyze them alongside Vercel's built-in observability data.

changelog_entries.title: Vercel Agent is now available in Slack code channels
changelog_entries.description: Start a code channel to give a task its own shared Vercel Agent session, where your team can send requests, review diffs, and coordinate together.

changelog_entries.title: Manage Vercel Container Registry with Vercel CLI
changelog_entries.description: Manage Vercel Container Registry with Vercel CLI. The new vercel vcr commands let you create and inspect repositories, browse images and tags, and connect your existing container tooling. Docker, Podman, and Buildah are all supported.
